notes.title: Update [version 1.7]
notes.content:
Update for LAMBDA end THEORY
(GB04212024)


Bluetooth controllers support.*
Minor changes to game controls.**
Add a menu to the Preferences.***

*: most Bluetooth controllers are compatible (with a few exceptions, such as Dual Sense).

**: with a controller, the "Start" button now opens the game menu.

***: It is now possible to redefine certain buttons on the controller for the main actions.

Thanks for your support!

P.S.: a new wallpaper is available in the game folder.

notes.title: Me && MORY is available + additional info!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As you already know, Me && MORY is available.

Thank you for your interest in this new game.

It takes place before LAMBDA end THEORY, and represents a first beginning of the story.
However, Me && MORY is also very cryptic and many elements are,
like the following game, open to interpretation.

In order to facilitate the understanding and to bring a chronology, all PIXLEAVES games
will be represented under the name of DATA + STARS Saga.

DATA + STARS Saga

DATA + STARS Saga is, as its name suggests, a saga of Data and Stars stories,
divided into several volumes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996250/61d6a15b9d69ac96227441b8cd1f41d00992a60a.png

Volume 1 is completed. It includes the following games:

Me && MORY
LAMBDA end THEORY
Thus, you can acquire them in bundle or separately.

In this regard, note that the soundtracks of the games are also available on Steam.

Future and Volume 2

Naturally, work on Volume 2 will begin this year to continue the story.
The next games will be in a different tone and will propose an evolution.
I can't wait to introduce them to you!

Thank you very much for your support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996250/189d248160c7a80a1a0d3479fc2f6681a7910fdc.jpg

notes.title: The Soundtrack is available!
notes.content:
The Soundtrack of LAMBDA end THEORY is available!

8 synthetic and nostalgic musics are waiting for you
- downloadable in high quality audio.

Synthetic and nostalgic, the soundtrack of LAMBDA end THEORY is,
like the game, pure and minimalist - it evokes a Past where each note counts
and gives life to a melody of memories.

You can buy it alone or in bundle with the game
(with a 15% saving on the total price).

Thanks again for your support! <3

Happy Holidays!

-

Instagram: @pixleaves
